note: Generated by scripts/m3/spec-checks.mjs (spec-autocite.mjs). IDs, rules and evidence only; no spec text.

not-a-requirement.clef-description: Clef kind "description" with no normative wording (must/should/never/always/don't/avoid/required/only) and no capability, default or behavior wording (can/may/by default/contains/when/if/appears/moves/expands/...; see CAPABILITY); not a short label (list item or table cell of <= 4 words)
not-a-requirement.clef-usage-advice: Clef kind "usage_advice", same wording conditions as clef-description
not-a-requirement.usage-section-designer: In a Guidelines > Usage / Best practices / Examples type section, a sentence addressed to the app designer ("Use X to/when/for", "X is best for", "can be used to/for/in", "Consider", "Choose")
not-a-requirement.designer-imperative: Clef kind "usage_advice" sentence that tells the designer which component or content to choose ("Use/Don't use/Avoid using/Choose/Consider/Place/Write/Keep ... concise")
not-a-requirement.table-status-cell: Table cell that only says Available / Yes / No / -- / N/A / (default), under generic column headers only (Attribute, Value, Status, M3 Expressive): the requirement is the row's label unit

auto-token.token-value: every dp / color role / shape / type scale / elevation value in the unit equals a resolved value of a gb token whose property, mixin or spec token names contain every subject word
auto-token.token-value-label-cell: token-value, with the subject from the table label cell before the value cell
auto-token.token-value-container: token-value of a size or shape stated for the component itself: matched against its container properties
auto-token.token-label-cell: a table label cell whose value cell is token-value-label-cell
auto-token.color-legend-tested: a lone color role in a Specs color legend (the numbered part is only in the image) that a generated spec test checks gb renders, for a token of this page and of the variant the section names

auto-section.specs-section-all-tokens: value-less captions/intros of a Specs color/measurements/tokens section whose every value-bearing unit is auto-token

cited.cluster: another member of the unit's cluster is cited
